stem.en: A gold film is evaporated onto glass. At an average thickness of 3 nm the coating already looks tinted, but it does not conduct between two contacts a millimetre apart. What is the most likely reason?
stem.et: Klaasile aurustatakse kuldkile. Keskmise paksuse 3 nm juures on kate juba silmaga tooniv, kuid see ei juhi voolu kahe millimeetrise vahega kontakti vahel. Mis on kõige tõenäolisem põhjus?

label.en: The gold has grown as separate islands that have not yet merged, so there is no continuous path across the gap
